relationships.subject: apremilast
relationships.evidence_quote: Compared with the control group, IL-17 treatment significantly increased the expression levels and secretions of IL-1β and MCP-1 at both mRNA and protein levels, which were reduced by apremilast in a dose-dependent manner (Fig. 1B and C).

relationships.subject: apremilast
relationships.evidence_quote: As anticipated, apremilast rescued the expression of SIRT1 reduced by IL-17.

relationships.subject: apremilast
relationships.evidence_quote: Collectively, the present findings revealed that apremilast possessed a protective capacity against IL-17-induced cellular senescence in chondrocytes.

relationships.subject: apremilast
relationships.evidence_quote: Apremilast, an oral phosphodiesterase 4 (PDE4) inhibitor, was approved by the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) in 2014

key_findings: Apremilast reduced IL-17-induced IL-1beta, MCP-1, ROS, p21, PAI-1, G0/G1 arrest and SA-beta-gal senescence in ATDC5 chondrocytes.
SIRT1 silencing abolished apremilast's anti-senescence effect, showing SIRT1 dependence.
